mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.reply_user_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.anonymous, c.create_time, c.deleted, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名用户' ELSE u.nickname END AS nickname, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = 1 THEN '/uploads/avatar/default.svg' ELSE u.avatar END AS avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
